programme.title: The Loyalty Game[Live]
programme.desc: A wife puts her husband to a simple loyalty test, unaware she will unleash a dangerous game of seduction, secrets, and deadly deception. After a troubled night leaves Ana waking up without her husband Ben by her side, she hires Beth to test his loyalty by seducing him. The connivance between wife and loyalty tester soon turns into a dangerous, seductive psychological game of secrets, manipulation, and power play, where loyalty becomes a matter of life and death.

programme.title: The Iron Heart
programme.desc: The Iron Heart follows Apollo Adelantar, an undercover operative with a traumatic past who is assigned to infiltrate a powerful crime syndicate. As he goes deeper into his dangerous mission, Apollo is forced to confront painful truths about his identity, loyalty, and family-especially when trusted allies turn into enemies. Fueled by vengeance, justice, and his desire to protect the innocent, Apollo and his companions face relentless trials that test not only their strength but also their moral convictions.

programme.title: E109 - Tres Leches Trouble / Wizzle Wozzle Woo
programme.desc: Dora, Boots, and Benny have to trek through the rainforest to deliver a big, delicate tres leches cake to Benny's abuela. // Dora and the Fiesta Trio investigate a loud, strange noise that caused them to lose their instruments.

programme.title: E204 - No Picnic / Gnome Mystery
programme.desc: Daisy and Mr. Crocodile throw a community picnic to help their neighbors become friends. // Daisy and Mr. Crocodile investigate who has broken Martin's garden gnome.

programme.title: E121 - Greedyguts / Where Is Bali?
programme.desc: A goat has escaped from the mountain and is coming to wreak havoc, devouring everything in its path! // Bali is nowhere to be found, and the Barbapapa deploy all their imagination to look for her. They have no idea that a nice surprise awaits them!

programme.title: E311 - Pups Save The Polar Bears / A Pup In Sheep's Clothing
programme.desc: Ryder and the pups must fly to the Arctic in the Air Patroller to rescue the lost cubs. // When little lambs keep running away from Farmer Al's pasture, it's up to the Paw Patrol to find the missing sheep.

programme.title: E1107 - Pups Save The Mountain Surfers / Pups Save Humdinger's Home Away From Home
programme.desc: Zuma and Hurricane Harrigan are about to go kitesurfing when a mighty wind sweeps them off the beach. // Mayor Humdinger takes his trailer and his kitties out for a sunny, desert vacation.

programme.title: E409 - Dora's Mermaid Adventure / Mermazing Surprise
programme.desc: Dora and Boots become mermaids and help Marisol the Mermaid save her home, Sirena Sea! // Dora and Boots go across the sea to help their dolphin friend find the best gift ever, a magic jewel!

programme.title: E213 - Watch Out For Barbabright / If I Were A Billionaire
programme.desc: The twins visit Barbabright's room. // If I were a billionaire, what would I do to achieve my dreams?

programme.desc: 由周杰倫擔當音樂造夢者，召集夢想生活官劉畊宏和夢想見證官王鶴棣，及四組廠牌經理人GAI周延&布瑞吉Bridge、歐陽靖&小鬼王琳凱、艾熱&早安、VaVa&盛宇，一同為說唱新生代們的追夢之旅保駕護航；打破傳統導師帶隊模式，通過構建真實師徒關系，共同打造獨具特色的說唱廠牌；透過競演激發說唱歌手創作才華，在全民中尋找下一個說唱巨星。

programme.desc: 專為資深單身人士定制的相親交友節目，每集有4位男嘉賓和3位女嘉賓，依序進行一對一交流。未上場嘉賓則分別在男女嘉賓室觀察場上溝通情況，加深對有意對象的瞭解。節目主張為愛回歸，愛情不分年齡，緣來從來不晚。

programme.title: E9
programme.desc: 圍繞雙重生的復仇主線展開，女主角姜樂瑤慘死後重生，發現閨蜜蓉兒頂替了自己的身份嫁入寧府，前一世她被嫁給痴傻少爺，更發現父母並非死於意外而是被人所害；這一世，她與同樣重生的伙伴聯手，直面寧府權貴的迫害，在身份置換與權謀博弈中揭露真相，為自己討回公道。

programme.title: E58
programme.desc: 一位在凡塵界備受冷遇的亡國公主箜篌，因機緣巧合意外進入修仙世界，開啟全員寵女主模式，整個修仙界都對女主寵愛有加，為了吃苦頭，磨練心智，箜篌主動走出舒適圈，要求下山闖蕩，偶遇了病弱男子桓宗一起升級打怪闖蕩修仙界，沒想到桓宗竟然是傳說中的修仙界天才，箜篌順利把桓宗拐回了門派當女婿，兩人也在一次次的歷練中克服了心魔，突破修為，雙雙成為了一代宗師。

programme.desc: 遊遍江蘇全省的名勝古蹟和大街小巷，尋訪文史學家、學者，走訪民間藝人工匠等，探尋風景背後的動人故事，深度觸摸江蘇的文化脈搏，帶領大家發現江蘇的獨特魅力。

programme.desc: 《九霄寒夜暖》主要講述了機智女捕快蘇玖兒搭檔冷峻祺族少主寒猙探九霄迷案，展開一段甜蜜“溫差戀愛”的故事。 該劇講述了乾國“畏寒”女捕快蘇玖兒與祺族“內熱”少主寒猙因關乎兩族關係的離奇兇案相遇，機緣下組成“溫差搭檔”，攜手穿破陰謀迷霧，尋找案件背後真相的同時化解家國危機故事。
